notes: Admin access fix - Discord Administrator users can use agent commands, not only ownerId.
Persistent timers - timer, alarm, sleep mode, and auto-unmute are saved to the repo and restored after GitHub Actions restarts.
Mute-for reliability - temporary voice mutes such as 30 minutes no longer disappear silently when the runner restarts.
Cleaner boot logs - startup now reports restored active timers and whether repo persistence is available.
